
# Main Data Processing

```{r process-non-stress-data}
# join survey responses with data dictionary
surveys_enriched_no_stress <- surveys_clean %>%
  # filter out stress surveys
  filter(str_detect(surveydisplayname, "(S|s)tress", negate = T)) %>%
  left_join(data_dict_clean,
            by = c("surveyname", "stepidentifier", "resultidentifier")) %>%
  # clean answers field (remove quotes and parse JSON-like strings)
  mutate(
    answer_clean = str_remove_all(answers, '^"|"$'),
    answer_clean = case_when(
      answer_clean == "true" ~ "Yes",
      answer_clean == "false" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ answer_clean
    ),
    # Add time-based variables for longitudinal analysis
    days_since_enrollment = as.numeric(recorded_date - as.Date(enroll_date)),
  ) %>%
  # Filter out rows without dictionary matches (administrative surveys)
  filter(!is.na(survey_topic))  %>%
  # Select key columns for analysis
  select(
    patient_id, FamilyID, 
    # fam_pos, 
    # vit_status_exp,
    recorded_date, 
    # recorded_dttm, 
    enroll_date,
    # days_since_enrollment, 
    # survey_wave_exp, survey_period,
    survey_topic, survey_display_name, survey_type,
    # step_readable, 
    question_readable,
    answer_clean, 
    possible_answers,
    # invitation_status, enrolled, active_kitstatus
  )
```


```{r process-stress-data}
# questions needing reverse score
reverse_qs <- c(4, 5, 7, 8)

# filter for stress surveys
surveys_enriched_stress <- surveys_clean %>%
  filter(str_detect(surveydisplayname, "(S|s)tress")) %>%
  left_join(data_dict_clean %>% filter(survey_type == "QT", str_detect(surveyname, "(S|s)tress")),
            by = c("surveyname", "surveyversion", "stepidentifier", "resultidentifier")) %>%
  # arrange by patient ID, recorded dttm, and question
  arrange(patient_id, recorded_dttm, question_readable) %>%
  # remove any duplicate records from the same patient on the same day 
  distinct(patient_id, recorded_date, question_readable, .keep_all = T) %>%
  # update survey type
  mutate(
    months_since_enroll = time_length(as_date(recorded_dttm) - as_date(enroll_date), unit = "month"),
    survey_type = case_when(months_since_enroll < 2.9 ~ "BL",
                            months_since_enroll >= 2.9 ~ "QT")
  ) %>%
  # clean answers field (remove quotes and parse JSON-like strings)
  mutate(
    answer_clean = str_remove_all(answers, '^"|"$'),
    answer_clean = case_when(
      answer_clean == "true" ~ "Yes",
      answer_clean == "false" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ answer_clean
    ),
    # Add time-based variables for longitudinal analysis
    days_since_enrollment = as.numeric(recorded_date - as.Date(enroll_date)),
  ) %>%
  # Filter out rows without dictionary matches (administrative surveys)
  filter(!is.na(survey_topic))  %>%
  # compute single stress score as per PSS directions
  mutate(
    stress_score = factor(answer_clean, 
                          levels = c("never",
                                     "almost never",
                                     "sometimes",
                                     "fairly often",
                                     "very often"),
                          labels = 0:4),
    # reverse the score for Q4, 5, 7, and 8
    stress_score_v2 = case_when(
      str_extract(question_readable, "^\\d+") %in% as.character(reverse_qs) ~ fct_recode(
        stress_score,
        `0` = "4",
        `1` = "3",
        `2` = "2",
        `3` = "1",
        `4` = "0"
      ),
      .default = stress_score
    )
  ) %>%
  # replace answer_clean and possible_answers with stress scores
  mutate(
    answer_clean = stress_score_v2,
    possible_answers = str_flatten_comma(str_c(0:4))
  ) %>%
  # Select key columns for analysis
  select(
    patient_id, FamilyID, 
    # fam_pos, 
    # vit_status_exp,
    recorded_date, 
    # recorded_dttm, 
    enroll_date,
    # days_since_enrollment, 
    # survey_wave_exp, survey_period,
    survey_topic, 
    survey_display_name=surveydisplayname, 
    surveyversion,
    survey_type,
    # step_readable, 
    question_readable,
    answer_clean, 
    # stress_score_v2,
    possible_answers,
    # invitation_status, enrolled, active_kitstatus
  )
```


```{r process-main-data}

  arrange(patient_id, recorded_date, survey_topic)

survey_topics_names <- unique(surveys_enriched$survey_topic)

cat("Enriched dataset shape:", nrow(surveys_enriched), "x", ncol(surveys_enriched), "\n")
```

```{r split-into-topics}
get_topic <- function(topic) {
  
  # check if topic is valid
  if (!(topic %in% survey_topics_names)) {
    stop(
      paste0("Error: '", topic_name, "' is not a recognized survey topic. ",
             "Allowed topics are: ", paste(allowed_topics, collapse = ", "), ".")
    )
  }
  
  
  topic_df <- surveys_enriched %>%
    filter(survey_topic == topic) %>%
    select(patient_id, FamilyID, recorded_date,
           enroll_date, 
           # days_since_enrollment,
           # survey_wave, survey_period, 
           survey_type,
           question_readable,
           answer_clean)
  
  return(topic_df)
}

# create DFs for each survey topic except stress
env_df <- get_topic("environmental exposures") 
health_df <- get_topic("general health")
life_changes_df <- get_topic("life changes")
skin_type_df <- get_topic("skin type")
vitiligo_df <- get_topic("vitiligo")
stress_df <- get_topic("stress") %>%
  summarize(
    stress_score = sum(as.integer(answer_clean), na.rm = T),
    .by = c(patient_id, FamilyID, recorded_date, enroll_date, survey_type)
  )
```

```{r results='asis', echo=FALSE}
The data frame `surveys_enriched` shows all readable survey responses across all participants, timepoints, and topics, in long format.
This means every individual question response is visible, with clear labels for who answered, what, and when.

The following data frames present the same survey responses, but organized by major topic area:

* `env_df`: Environmental exposure survey responses

* `health_df`: General health and medical history responses

* `life_changes_df`: Life changes and major events responses

* `skin_type_df`: Participant skin/eye/hair characteristics (baseline only)

* `vitiligo_df`: Vitiligo-specific questions and treatments

* `stress_df`: Computed stress scores from a 10-question questionnaire (higher score = more stress)
    - This DF slightly differs from the rest...
        - Each row represents a participant's overall stress score at the time of submission (1 row per survey instead of 1 row per question)
        - The field `stress_score` replaced `answer_clean`
        - The field `question_readable` was removed

")
```

```{r vitiligo_survey_exploratory}
answers_per_participant <- vitiligo_df %>%
  # clean blanks; treat "" and literal "NA" as missing
  mutate(answer_clean = str_squish(answer_clean),
         answer_clean = na_if(answer_clean, ""),
         answer_clean = na_if(answer_clean, "NA")) %>%
  # explode multi-selects like "Topical steroids; Phototherapy"
  separate_rows(answer_clean, sep = "\\s*[,;]\\s*") %>%
  filter(!is.na(answer_clean)) %>%
  group_by(FamilyID, patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_answers   = n_distinct(answer_clean),
    n_total_responses  = n(),                              # optional: total rows after splitting
    n_unique_questions = n_distinct(question_readable),    # optional: distinct questions answered
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(FamilyID, patient_id)
```

```{r plotting_vitiligo1}
# 1) Parse recorded_date to a pure Date (ignore time-of-day)
vitiligo_clean <- vitiligo_df %>%
  mutate(
    # Try multiple formats; coalesce the first that works
    rec_dt = dplyr::coalesce(
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd_hms(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::ymd(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::mdy_hms(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::mdy(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::dmy_hms(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      suppressWarnings(lubridate::dmy(recorded_date, quiet = TRUE)),
      # If it's already Date/POSIXct, as_datetime/as_date will just work
      suppressWarnings(as_datetime(recorded_date))
    ),
    rec_date = as.Date(rec_dt)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rec_date))

# 2) Count distinct recorded dates per participant per question
dates_per_q <- vitiligo_clean %>%
  group_by(FamilyID, patient_id, question_readable) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct_dates = n_distinct(rec_date), .groups = "drop")

# 3) Make a nice participant label and sort by FamilyID then patient_id
dates_per_q <- vitiligo_clean %>%
  group_by(FamilyID, patient_id, question_readable) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct_dates = n_distinct(rec_date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(FamilyID, patient_id, question_readable) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_label = fct_inorder(patient_id)  # lock y-axis to current order
  )

ggplot(dates_per_q,
       aes(x = question_readable, y = participant_label, fill = n_distinct_dates)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "# distinct dates", low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Question", y = "Participant (sorted by FamilyID)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())


```


Now that we have a sense of what the data is, let us try to figure out whether we got many new spots since we began

```{r q7_with_AH_and_treating_fixed, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

q7_txt <- "Have your existing spots changed in the last 3 months (shrinking or growing)?"
q6_txt <- "Are you currently treating your vitiligo?"

# -- helpers
norm_stype <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  recode(x,
    "BASELINE"="BL", "BL "="BL",
    "QUARTERLY"="QT", "QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT", "QTR"="QT",
    "AD-HOC"="AH", "AD HOC"="AH", "ADHOC"="AH",
    .default = x
  )
}
norm_yesno <- function(x) {
  s <- str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(s, "^(yes|y|true|1)$") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(s, "^(no|n|false|0)$") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# -- standardize once
v <- vitiligo_df %>%
  mutate(
    survey_type   = norm_stype(survey_type),
    recorded_date = as.Date(recorded_date)
  )

# -- Q7 rows
q7 <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q7_txt) %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id, recorded_date, survey_type,
    answer = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(answer_clean), "no[_ ]?change|same|unchang") ~ "no change",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(answer_clean), "shrink")                     ~ "shrinking",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(answer_clean), "grow")                       ~ "growing",
      TRUE ~ answer_clean
    )
  )

# -- Treating rows (same-day signal)
treat <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q6_txt) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, treating_same = norm_yesno(answer_clean)) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, recorded_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 1) same-day join first
q7_same <- q7 %>% left_join(treat, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date"))

# 2) build a timeline and carry forward last known treating within a window
max_gap_days <- 120L  # adjust as you like; 0 = disable carry; Inf = always carry

timeline <- bind_rows(
  q7_same %>% mutate(source = "q7",    source_ord = 1L),
  treat   %>% mutate(survey_type = NA_character_, answer = NA_character_,
                     source = "treat", source_ord = 0L)
) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, recorded_date, source_ord) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    # real columns to fill down
    treating_ffill = treating_same,                               # start as same-day; will fill
    treat_date     = if_else(source == "treat", recorded_date, NA_Date_)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::fill(treating_ffill, treat_date, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) keep only Q7 rows and finalize treating with window logic
q7_aug <- timeline %>%
  filter(source == "q7") %>%
  mutate(
    days_since_last_treat = as.integer(recorded_date - treat_date),
    treating_final = case_when(
      !is.na(treating_same) ~ treating_same,  # exact same-day answer
      !is.na(treating_ffill) & (is.infinite(max_gap_days) | days_since_last_treat <= max_gap_days) ~ treating_ffill,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    treating_final = fct_relevel(fct_explicit_na(treating_final, "Unknown"), "Yes", "No", "Unknown"),
    treating_source = case_when(
      !is.na(treating_same) ~ "same-day",
      !is.na(treating_ffill) & (is.infinite(max_gap_days) | days_since_last_treat <= max_gap_days) ~ "carried",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

# ---- Plot A: counts by survey_type (BL/QT/AH)
v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q7_txt) %>%
  count(survey_type, answer_clean) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = answer_clean, y = n, fill = survey_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL" = "black", "QT" = "gray60", "AH" = "gray20"),
                    na.translate = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Answer", y = "Count", fill = "Survey type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# ---- Plot B: facet by survey_type, split by Treating?
plot_df <- q7_aug %>%
  count(survey_type, answer, treating = treating_final)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = answer, y = n, fill = treating)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ survey_type, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "black", "No" = "gray60", "Unknown" = "white")) +
  labs(x = "Answer", y = "Count", fill = "Treating?") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

# (optional QC: see where treating labels come from)
# q7_aug %>% count(survey_type, treating_source)
```



```{r vitiligo_new_spots_with_AH, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

q1_txt_main <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think could be vitiligo?"
q1_txt_ah   <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think can be vitiligo or improvement (repigmentation) of your vitiligo?"
q12_txt     <- "Do you have vitiligo?"

# which AH codes count as "new white spot" (edit this if you change your mind)
ah_newspot_codes <- c(1) #1 = New white spot(s), 2= Improvement, 3 = neither

norm_stype <- function(x){
  x <- toupper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::recode(x,
    "BASELINE"="BL", "BL "="BL",
    "QUARTERLY"="QT", "QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT", "QTR"="QT",
    "AD-HOC"="AH", "AD HOC"="AH", "ADHOC"="AH",
    .default = x
  )
}
norm_yesno <- function(x){
  s <- str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(s, "^(yes|y|true|1)$") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(s, "^(no|n|false|0)$") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# --- normalize survey_type once ---
v <- vitiligo_df %>% mutate(survey_type = norm_stype(survey_type))

# --- 1) Baseline (BL) vitiligo status from Q12 (same as before) ---
bl_status <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt, survey_type == "BL") %>%
  transmute(patient_id, has_vitiligo_bl = norm_yesno(answer_clean)) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(has_vitiligo_bl = forcats::fct_explicit_na(has_vitiligo_bl, "Unknown"))

# --- 2) Did they EVER report new white spots on Q1? (BL/QT normal Q1 + AH special Q1) ---
q1_any <- v %>%
  # keep the standard Q1 anywhere (BL/QT/AH) OR the AH mixed Q1
  filter(question_readable %in% c(q1_txt_main, q1_txt_ah)) %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id, survey_type, question_readable, answer_clean,
    is_yes = dplyr::case_when(
      # standard wording (any survey type): use Yes/No parser
      question_readable == q1_txt_main ~ (norm_yesno(answer_clean) == "Yes"),

      # AH mixed wording: treat numeric code 1 as "new white spot"
      question_readable == q1_txt_ah ~ {
        # pull a leading integer if present; NA if nothing numeric
        ans_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(answer_clean, "^\\d+")))
        !is.na(ans_num) & ans_num %in% ah_newspot_codes
      },

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

q1_ever <- q1_any %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(ever_yes = any(is_yes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- 3) Join + summarise by baseline group ---
summary_df <- bl_status %>%
  full_join(q1_ever, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    ever_yes = tidyr::replace_na(ever_yes, FALSE),
    has_vitiligo_bl = fct_relevel(has_vitiligo_bl, "Yes", "No", "Unknown")
  )

yes_summary <- summary_df %>%
  group_by(has_vitiligo_bl) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_yes   = sum(ever_yes),
    pct_yes = n_yes / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 4) Plot with explicit denominators in the labels ---
ggplot(yes_summary, aes(x = has_vitiligo_bl, y = n_yes, fill = has_vitiligo_bl)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n_yes, " / ", n_total, " (", scales::percent(pct_yes), ")")),
            vjust = -0.35, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "black", "No" = "gray60", "Unknown" = "white")) +
  labs(
    title = "Participants who EVER reported new white spots (Q1, incl. AH), by baseline vitiligo status",
    x = "Baseline vitiligo (from BL Q12)",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --- 5) Baseline counts table ---
bl_counts <- yes_summary %>%
  select(has_vitiligo_bl, n_total) %>%
  arrange(has_vitiligo_bl)
bl_counts
```



```{r violins_bl_qt_ah_ttests_counts, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---- setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(forcats); library(ggplot2)

q1_txt_main <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think could be vitiligo?"
q1_txt_ah   <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think can be vitiligo or improvement (repigmentation) of your vitiligo?"
q12_txt     <- "Do you have vitiligo?"
ah_newspot_codes <- c(1)  # edit if needed

norm_yesno <- function(x){
  s <- str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(s, "^(yes|y|true|1)$") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(s, "^(no|n|false|0)$") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}
norm_stype <- function(x){
  x <- str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  recode(x,
    "BASELINE"="BL","BL "="BL",
    "QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT","QTR"="QT",
    "AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
    .default = x
  )
}

v <- vitiligo_df %>%
  mutate(survey_type = norm_stype(survey_type),
         recorded_date = as.Date(recorded_date))

# Q12 gates
q12_yes_by_date <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, has_vitiligo = norm_yesno(answer_clean)) %>%
  filter(has_vitiligo == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, recorded_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

bl_q12_yes <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt, survey_type == "BL") %>%
  transmute(patient_id, bl_vit_yes = norm_yesno(answer_clean) == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, bl_vit_yes)

# Q1 per patient-date (standard + AH code 1)
q1_by_date <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable %in% c(q1_txt_main, q1_txt_ah)) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, survey_type, question_readable, answer_clean,
            q1_flag = case_when(
              question_readable == q1_txt_main ~ (norm_yesno(answer_clean) == "Yes"),
              question_readable == q1_txt_ah   ~ {
                ans_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(answer_clean, "^\\d+")))
                !is.na(ans_num) & ans_num %in% ah_newspot_codes
              },
              TRUE ~ FALSE
            )) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, recorded_date, survey_type) %>%
  summarise(q1_newspots = ifelse(any(q1_flag, na.rm = TRUE), "Yes", "No"), .groups = "drop")

# stress per day
stress_on_date <- stress_df %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date,
            survey_type = recode(str_to_upper(str_squish(survey_type)),
                                 "BASELINE"="BL","QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT",
                                 "QTR"="QT","AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
                                 .default = str_to_upper(survey_type)),
            stress_score)

# ---- PANEL 1: Baseline ---------------------------------------------------
bl_panel <- q1_by_date %>%
  filter(survey_type == "BL") %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date %>% filter(survey_type == "BL"),
             by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%  # just in case of duplicates
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(panel = "Baseline",
            group = if_else(q1_newspots=="Yes","New spots at BL","No new spots at BL"),
            flag  = if_else(q1_newspots=="Yes","Yes","No"),
            stress = stress_score)

# ---- PANEL 2: Follow-up (QT/AH) -----------------------------------------
# A) first QT/AH "Yes" with same-day stress
qtah_yes <- q1_by_date %>%
  filter(survey_type %in% c("QT","AH"), q1_newspots == "Yes") %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(patient_id, stress_yes = stress_score)

# B) participants who NEVER said Yes on QT/AH (use median of their QT/AH "No" stresses)
never_ids <- q1_by_date %>%
  filter(survey_type %in% c("QT","AH")) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(has_yes = any(q1_newspots=="Yes"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!has_yes) %>%
  pull(patient_id)

qtah_no <- q1_by_date %>%
  filter(survey_type %in% c("QT","AH"),
         patient_id %in% never_ids,
         q1_newspots == "No") %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(stress_no_med = median(stress_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

follow_panel <- bind_rows(
  qtah_yes %>% transmute(panel = "Follow-up (QT/AH)",
                         group = "Yes on QT/AH (same day)", flag = "Yes", stress = stress_yes),
  qtah_no  %>% transmute(panel = "Follow-up (QT/AH)",
                         group = "Never Yes on QT/AH",      flag = "No",  stress = stress_no_med)
)

# ---- combine + plot ------------------------------------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(bl_panel, follow_panel) %>%
  mutate(
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("Baseline","Follow-up (QT/AH)")),
    flag  = factor(flag,  levels = c("No","Yes")),
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("No new spots at BL","New spots at BL",
                              "Never Yes on QT/AH","Yes on QT/AH (same day)"))
  )

# p-values per panel (Welch; independent groups)
fmt_p <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(is.na(p) ~ "p = NA", p < 1e-4 ~ "p < 1e-4", TRUE ~ sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
tt <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_yes = sum(flag=="Yes"), n_no = sum(flag=="No"),
    p = { if(n_yes>1 && n_no>1){
            out <- try(t.test(stress ~ flag, data = cur_data(), var.equal = FALSE), silent=TRUE)
            if (inherits(out,"try-error")) NA_real_ else out$p.value
          } else NA_real_ },
    y_top = max(stress, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(lbl = paste0("Welch t-test, ", fmt_p(p)),
         y_bar = y_top + 0.11*y_top,
         y_cap = y_bar - 0.03*y_top)

# counts for labels
nn <- plot_df %>%
  count(panel, group, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(plot_df %>% group_by(panel) %>% summarise(y_top = max(stress, na.rm=TRUE)), by = "panel") %>%
  mutate(y = y_top + 0.05*y_top)

# plot
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group, y = stress, fill = flag)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.14, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = "gray60", "Yes" = "tan"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 13, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 26, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Stress vs ‘new white spots?’ at Baseline and Follow-up",
    subtitle = "Follow-up: first QT/AH ‘Yes’ (same day) vs participants who never said ‘Yes’ on QT/AH",
    x = NULL, y = "Stress score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 12, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.20))) +
  # n labels
  geom_text(data = nn, aes(x = group, y = y, label = paste0("n = ", n)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2) +
  # bracket + p-value per panel
  geom_segment(data = tt, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_bar, yend = y_bar),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = tt, aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_bar, yend = y_cap),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = tt, aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_bar, yend = y_cap),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = tt, aes(x = 1.5, y = y_bar + 0.04*y_top, label = lbl),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.2)
```

Let us test for bimodality

```{r vitiligo_test_bimodality}
# --- helpers ---
bc_stats <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 4) return(c(bc = NA_real_, skew = NA_real_, beta2 = NA_real_))
  m  <- mean(x)
  c2 <- mean((x - m)^2)
  c3 <- mean((x - m)^3)
  c4 <- mean((x - m)^4)
  skew  <- if (c2 > 0) c3 / (c2^(3/2)) else NA_real_
  beta2 <- if (c2 > 0) c4 / (c2^2) else NA_real_  # Pearson kurtosis (not "excess")
  bc    <- (skew^2 + 1) / beta2                   # Sarle's bimodality coefficient
  c(bc = bc, skew = skew, beta2 = beta2)
}

kde_modes <- function(x, bw = "SJ") {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 5) return(NA_integer_)
  b <- if (bw == "SJ") bw.SJ(x) else if (bw == "nrd0") bw.nrd0(x) else bw
  d <- density(x, bw = b)
  peaks <- which(diff(sign(diff(d$y))) < 0)  # local maxima
  length(peaks)
}

# --- compute metrics per panel (BL/QT x Yes/No) ---
bimod_tbl <- anal_df %>%
  group_by(survey_type, q1_newspots) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = sum(is.finite(stress_score)),
    # Dip test (unimodality)
    dip_stat = { tmp <- dip.test(stress_score); unname(tmp$statistic) },
    dip_p    = { tmp <- dip.test(stress_score); tmp$p.value },
    # Silverman test (bootstrap KDE); skip for tiny n to keep it fast/stable
    silver_p = if (n >= 20) {
      tryCatch(
        as.numeric(modetest(stress_score, method = "SI", B = 999, k = 1)$p.value),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else NA_real_,
    # Bimodality coefficient
    bc       = { s <- bc_stats(stress_score); s[["bc"]] },
    # KDE peak count
    kde_modes = kde_modes(stress_score, "SJ"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # simple flag: any one of the signals trips
    possible_bimodal = (bc > 5/9) | (!is.na(dip_p) & dip_p < 0.05) | (!is.na(silver_p) & silver_p < 0.05)
  )

bimod_tbl
```

```{r bl_qt_yes_counts_and_paired_plots_v2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("BL Yes & QT Yes",

  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, cohort, phase, stress) %>%
  filter(is.finite(stress))

# ---- Ns and p-values per facet ----
n_phase <- paired_long %>% count(cohort, phase, name = "n")

# paired t + Wilcoxon
get_paired_tests <- function(df) {
  wide <- df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = stress)
  cols <- setdiff(names(wide), "patient_id")
  if (length(cols) != 2) return(tibble(t_p = NA_real_, w_p = NA_real_))
  x <- wide[[cols[1]]]; y <- wide[[cols[2]]]  # BL first (by factor order), QT second
  tt <- try(stats::t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  wx <- try(stats::wilcox.test(y, x, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
  tibble(
    t_p = if (inherits(tt,"try-error")) NA_real_ else tt$p.value,
    w_p = if (inherits(wx,"try-error")) NA_real_ else wx$p.value
  )
}
tests <- paired_long %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~ get_paired_tests(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    t_lab = case_when(is.na(t_p) ~ "t: p = NA", t_p < 1e-4 ~ "t: p < 1e-4", TRUE ~ sprintf("t: p = %.3f", t_p)),
    w_lab = case_when(is.na(w_p) ~ "W: p = NA", w_p < 1e-4 ~ "W: p < 1e-4", TRUE ~ sprintf("W: p = %.3f", w_p))
  )
```

```{r bl_qt_yes_counts_and_paired_plots_v3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Minimal helpers to parse types & Q12 gate for AH rows
norm_stype <- function(x){
  x <- stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_squish(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::recode(x,
    "BASELINE"="BL","BL "="BL",
    "QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT","QTR"="QT",
    "AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
    .default = x
  )
}
norm_yesno <- function(x){
  s <- stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_squish(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_detect(s, "^(yes|y|true|1)$") ~ "Yes",
    stringr::str_detect(s, "^(no|n|false|0)$") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Text for the AH mixed Q1
q1_txt_ah <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think can be vitiligo or improvement (repigmentation) of your vitiligo?"
q12_txt   <- "Do you have vitiligo?"
ah_code_newspot <- 1
ah_code_shrink  <- 2

# normalize a local copy "v" for AH work
v <- vitiligo_df %>%
  mutate(
    survey_type   = norm_stype(survey_type),
    recorded_date = as.Date(recorded_date)
  )

# same-day Q12 Yes and BL Q12 Yes as gate
q12_yes_by_date <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, has_vitiligo = norm_yesno(answer_clean)) %>%
  filter(has_vitiligo == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, recorded_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

bl_q12_yes <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt, survey_type == "BL") %>%
  transmute(patient_id, bl_vit_yes = norm_yesno(answer_clean) == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, bl_vit_yes)

# stress (includes AH if present)
stress_on_date <- stress_df %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id, recorded_date,
    survey_type = dplyr::recode(stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_squish(survey_type)),
                                "BASELINE"="BL","QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT",
                                "QTR"="QT","AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
                                .default = stringr::str_to_upper(survey_type)),
    stress_score
  )

# Pull AH answers & numeric code
ah_q1 <- v %>%
  filter(survey_type == "AH", question_readable == q1_txt_ah) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, survey_type,
            code = suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(answer_clean, "^\\d+"))))

# First AH code=1 (new spot) day with same-day stress and Q12 gate
ah1_first <- ah_q1 %>%
  filter(code == ah_code_newspot) %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date %>% filter(survey_type == "AH"),
             by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  summarise(ah_code1_first = first(stress_score), .groups = "drop")

# First AH code=2 (shrinking) day with same-day stress and Q12 gate
ah2_first <- ah_q1 %>%
  filter(code == ah_code_shrink) %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date %>% filter(survey_type == "AH"),
             by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  summarise(ah_code2_first = first(stress_score), .groups = "drop")

# Join AH to BL stress; build two more cohorts
dat_ah <- bl_stress %>%
  left_join(ah1_first, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(ah2_first, by = "patient_id")

# build extra AH cohorts (same as you had)
cohort_E <- dat_ah %>%
  filter(is.finite(bl_stress), is.finite(ah_code1_first)) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, cohort = "BL → AH code 1",
            phase1 = "BL (baseline)",            s1 = bl_stress,
            phase2 = "AH (code 1: new spot)",    s2 = ah_code1_first)

cohort_F <- dat_ah %>%
  filter(is.finite(bl_stress), is.finite(ah_code2_first)) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, cohort = "BL → AH code 2",
            phase1 = "BL (baseline)",            s1 = bl_stress,
            phase2 = "AH (code 2: shrinking)",   s2 = ah_code2_first)

paired_long_extra <- bind_rows(cohort_E, cohort_F) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(s1, s2), names_to = "slot", values_to = "stress") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phase = dplyr::if_else(slot == "s1", phase1, phase2, missing = NA_character_),
    phase = as.character(phase)  # <- force character, not logical/factor
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patient_id, cohort, phase, stress) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(stress))

# also make sure the original is character before binding
paired_long <- paired_long %>% dplyr::mutate(phase = as.character(phase))

# now this will work
paired_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(paired_long, paired_long_extra)

# Factor levels so BL always on the left
phase_levels <- c("BL (Q1=Yes)", "BL (Q1=No)", "BL (baseline)",
                  "QT (all No)", "QT (first Yes)",
                  "AH (code 1: new spot)", "AH (code 2: shrinking)")
paired_long <- paired_long %>%
  mutate(
    phase  = factor(phase, levels = phase_levels),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("BL Yes & QT Yes",
                                       "BL Yes & QT never Yes",
                                       "BL No & QT Yes",
                                       "BL No & QT never Yes",
                                       "BL → AH code 1",
                                       "BL → AH code 2"))
  )

# Ns and paired tests per facet
n_phase <- paired_long %>% count(cohort, phase, name = "n")

get_paired_tests <- function(df) {
  wide <- df %>% pivot_wider(names_from = phase, values_from = stress)
  cols <- setdiff(names(wide), "patient_id")
  if (length(cols) != 2) return(tibble(t_p = NA_real_, w_p = NA_real_))
  x <- wide[[cols[1]]]; y <- wide[[cols[2]]]  # BL left, follow-up right
  tt <- try(stats::t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  wx <- try(stats::wilcox.test(y, x, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
  tibble(
    t_p = if (inherits(tt,"try-error")) NA_real_ else tt$p.value,
    w_p = if (inherits(wx,"try-error")) NA_real_ else wx$p.value
  )
}
tests <- paired_long %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~ get_paired_tests(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    t_lab = case_when(is.na(t_p) ~ "t: p = NA", t_p < 1e-4 ~ "t: p < 1e-4", TRUE ~ sprintf("t: p = %.3f", t_p)),
    w_lab = case_when(is.na(w_p) ~ "W: p = NA", w_p < 1e-4 ~ "W: p < 1e-4", TRUE ~ sprintf("W: p = %.3f", w_p))
  )

cut_low_med  <- 13
cut_med_high <- 26

y_top <- paired_long %>% group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(y = max(stress, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p <- ggplot(paired_long, aes(x = phase, y = stress, fill = phase)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cut_low_med,  linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cut_med_high, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "gray30") +
  geom_line(aes(group = patient_id), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4,
            position = position_jitter(width = 0.02, height = 0)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, width = 0.9, color = "grey35") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.14, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.55, color = "grey10") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "BL (Q1=Yes)"            = "tan",
    "QT (first Yes)"         = "tan",
    "AH (code 1: new spot)"  = "tan",
    "BL (Q1=No)"             = "gray60",
    "QT (all No)"            = "gray60",
    "BL (baseline)"          = "gray60",
    "AH (code 2: shrinking)" = "gray60"
  )) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Paired stress comparisons by cohort (incl. Ad-Hoc)",
    subtitle = "QT facets as before; extra facets compare BL vs first AH code 1 (new spot) and BL vs first AH code 2 (shrinking)",
    x = NULL, y = "Stress score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 28, b = 10, l = 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.20))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

p
```

```{r test}
# ---- AH SECTION (v2) -----------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(tidyr)

q12_txt   <- "Do you have vitiligo?"
q1_txt_ah <- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think can be vitiligo or improvement (repigmentation) of your vitiligo?"
q1_txt_std<- "Have you noticed any new white spots on your skin that you think could be vitiligo?"

norm_stype <- function(x){
  x <- str_to_upper(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  recode(x,
    "BASELINE"="BL","QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT","QTR"="QT",
    "AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
    .default = x
  )
}
norm_yesno <- function(x){
  s <- str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(x)))
  case_when(
    str_detect(s, "^(yes|y|true|1)$") ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(s, "^(no|n|false|0)$") ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

v <- vitiligo_df %>% mutate(survey_type = norm_stype(survey_type),
                            recorded_date = as.Date(recorded_date))

# Q12 gate
q12_yes_by_date <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, has_vitiligo = norm_yesno(answer_clean)) %>%
  filter(has_vitiligo == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, recorded_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

bl_q12_yes <- v %>%
  filter(question_readable == q12_txt, survey_type == "BL") %>%
  transmute(patient_id, bl_vit_yes = norm_yesno(answer_clean) == "Yes") %>%
  distinct(patient_id, bl_vit_yes)

# Stress (normalize types to include AH)
stress_on_date <- stress_df %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id, recorded_date,
    survey_type = recode(str_to_upper(str_squish(survey_type)),
                         "BASELINE"="BL","QUARTERLY"="QT","QUARTERLY CHECK-IN"="QT","QTR"="QT",
                         "AD-HOC"="AH","AD HOC"="AH","ADHOC"="AH",
                         .default = str_to_upper(survey_type)),
    stress_score
  )

# AH Q1 parser: support both AH phrasings; prefer numeric codes if present
ah_events <- v %>%
  filter(survey_type == "AH",
         str_detect(question_readable, fixed("Have you noticed any new white spots", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, recorded_date, survey_type,
            # try to parse a leading numeric code (1=new, 2=shrinking)
            code = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(answer_clean, "^\\d+"))),
            # if no code but it's the standard wording, fall back to Yes/No
            yn   = if_else(question_readable == q1_txt_std, norm_yesno(answer_clean), NA_character_))

# same-day join to stress + Q12 gate
ah_with_stress <- ah_events %>%
  inner_join(stress_on_date %>% filter(survey_type == "AH"),
             by = c("patient_id","recorded_date","survey_type")) %>%
  left_join(q12_yes_by_date, by = c("patient_id","recorded_date")) %>%
  left_join(bl_q12_yes,      by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(has_vitiligo) | bl_vit_yes)

# first AH code=1 day
ah1_first <- ah_with_stress %>%
  filter(code == 1 | (is.na(code) & yn == "Yes")) %>%   # allow std Yes as "new spot" if no code
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  summarise(ah_code1_first = first(stress_score), .groups = "drop")

# first AH code=2 day (shrinking) — only from coded AH
ah2_first <- ah_with_stress %>%
  filter(code == 2) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(recorded_date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  summarise(ah_code2_first = first(stress_score), .groups = "drop")

# BL baseline stress you already computed (bl_stress). Join and build cohorts:
dat_ah <- bl_stress %>%
  left_join(ah1_first, by = "patient_id") %>%
  left_join(ah2_first, by = "patient_id")

cohort_E <- dat_ah %>%
  filter(is.finite(bl_stress), is.finite(ah_code1_first)) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, cohort = "BL → AH code 1",
            phase1 = "BL (baseline)", s1 = bl_stress,
            phase2 = "AH (code 1: new spot)", s2 = ah_code1_first)

cohort_F <- dat_ah %>%
  filter(is.finite(bl_stress), is.finite(ah_code2_first)) %>%
  transmute(patient_id, cohort = "BL → AH code 2",
            phase1 = "BL (baseline)", s1 = bl_stress,
            phase2 = "AH (code 2: shrinking)", s2 = ah_code2_first)

# long format; force character for safe binding
paired_long_extra <- bind_rows(cohort_E, cohort_F) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(s1, s2), names_to = "slot", values_to = "stress") %>%
  mutate(
    phase = dplyr::if_else(slot == "s1", phase1, phase2, missing = NA_character_),
    phase = as.character(phase)
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, cohort, phase, stress) %>%
  filter(is.finite(stress))
```
